evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'Let's get you quoted it. Let's start with a few questions to get you on the right track. That should take about five to ten minutes of your time. Then we can be able to build you an accurate code you can depend on. Sounds good.' — framing is present but rep doesn't wait for a genuine yes before pivoting to the agenda question.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks 'Do you have any concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer during this call today?' — but this comes after already asking 'when are you planning moving' and 'what are we moving', so probing has already started.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer says 'Nope, just trying to get an estimate' — no concerns raised, N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep covers storage type (climate controlled), dimensions (10x10 and 10x20), floor level (first floor), special items (refrigerator, stove), box count ('handful of boxes'), starting address (6857 South Staples, Corpus Christi 78413), destination address (21998 FM 574 W, Mallo Texas 76864), and property type at destination (two mobile homes on ranch). All seven logistics categories covered.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep asks 'Do you happen to know how many boxes are we moving?' Customer responds 'I don't think that there's more than handful of boxes there.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides typical range for 10x20 storage ('two movers between seven and a half to nine and a half hours locally') and personalizes to this customer's multi-day, two-truck scenario with distance breakdown. Final estimate: '$11,532 including everything including the trip fee taxes and also overnight fee.' Both elements present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep discloses trip fee ($290.4 per truck), overnight fee ($200-$240 per stop), hourly rate ($103 per hour per mover), truck inclusions (gas, wraps, pods, tools, disassembly/reassembly), 2.5-hour minimum, and 15-minute increment prorating. Also states 'there's no hidden fees of any type.' Full transparency present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: After quote, customer says 'Yeah, cause we had most of that stuff moved by two people into those storage units within a few hours.' Rep responds with explanation rather than asking 'Does that feel fair?' and holding silence. Not asked.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep states 'Finally, we have on time guarantee we all your time. So if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.' Discount terms clearly stated.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep states 'We have no worry damage coverage included on the early rate that you're paying us. We will provide up to $2,000 per that is to repair replace and reimburse for your items.' Covers $2,000 amount and that it's included (not an add-on), but does not explicitly state 'no deductible' or 'no fine print' framing — partial.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent. No loop closure attempted.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep never asks 'What's still concerning you?' or 'Any final concerns?' or even 'Any questions?' at the end. Moves directly to 'Would you like me to send you the email quotation.'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep does not ask 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep says 'Would you like me to send you the email quotation.' This is not a recognizable version of 'Would you like our help with your move?' It asks for a quote delivery, not a booking ask. Never asked.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep states 'there's no deposit required, no recent securing your spot.' Rate lock (no deposit to hold the spot) is mentioned.

top_strength: Rep gathered comprehensive logistics details across all seven categories (storage type, dimensions, floors, special items, box count, both addresses, destination property type) and delivered a detailed, personalized two-day estimate with transparent fee breakdown and full disclosure of guarantees and coverage.
coaching_note: Rep never asked for the business — the call ended with 'I'll send you the email' rather than 'Would you like our help with your move?' and no booking details (date, phone, arrival window, crew size, addresses) were confirmed, which means the customer left without a commitment and the rep has no record of what to do next.
